resources.title: SSRS Expression & Parameter Quick Reference
resources.description: A one-page syntax reference compiled directly from this course's own taught patterns — Fields!/Parameters! simple expressions, IIF/Switch conditional formatting, the three things that change for a multi-value parameter, the cascading-parameter Filters-tab pattern, parameter-driven dataset mapping, and the five .NET format strings (C2/N0/P0/d/D) used constantly throughout the course. Keep it open while building any report.

resources.title: AdventureWorks Product Catalog Sample Dataset
resources.description: A small CSV sample shaped exactly like Production.ProductCategory / ProductSubcategory / Product in AdventureWorks2012 — Category, Subcategory, Product name, and List Price. Use it to prototype a cascading Category → Subcategory → Product parameter chain in Excel or Power BI before touching Report Builder, or to sanity-check your own query results against a known-good set of rows.

resources.title: Paginated Report Design & QA Checklist
resources.description: A pre-deployment checklist covering page setup and print-layout pitfalls (Chapter 2), parameter and cascading-chain correctness (Chapter 3), expression/formatting hygiene (Chapter 4), and drillthrough wiring (Chapter 6) — every line traces back to a specific lesson so a failed check tells you exactly where to go re-read.
